why_no_new_terms: A drafting manual, and most of what it labels [K] is craft. The rule for a place is document 11's and the rule for anything else document 7's — both the documents' own sharpest statements, and this document's tables have the same shape. A place gets a page when a [K] sub-location row names specific chapters: every row that does (Wohneinheit 734, Sektor 04, Archiv der Grenzen, Mnemosyne-Server-Architektur, Mosaik-Herz, Verschränkungs-Insel, Garten der stillen Präsenz) already has one; the rest are anchored to „Kap 1 ff.“, to an act or to nothing, or are [V] or [L]. Anything else gets a page when a [K] passage says what a thing in the world is, and what it canonises of that kind — the six levels, the thermal rule, the Risse, the Genesis and its motifs, Mnemosyne's temptation — is a reading on a page the wiki has. The rest is craft (the briefing template, R-1 to R-10, the style levels, the foreshadowing strands, the anchor trackers, genre per act, a repository layout), borrowed theory in its home sense (Kant, Tarski, Iser, the genre benchmarks), or names used as known (Multiplizitäts-Schleier, Lernarchiv Theta-9, Gödel-Gambit, Slot-16). Wir-AEGIS-plural is used here as a name without being marked open; the page still waits for the author (J47, J73).
